subject.title: Models: fully dynamic model discovery (OpenRouter + beyond)

question: Should live provider catalogs automatically populate user-visible model pickers, and what filtering and allowlist policy should govern those entries?
rationale: The implementation seam exists, but source inspection cannot choose catalog scale, safety and cost authority, metadata trust, refresh lifecycle, or offline UX without maintainer intent.

options.title: Filtered provider catalogs
options.body: Let provider plugins refresh live catalogs while core preserves the existing allowlist and applies provider-owned capability or recommendation filters to pickers.

options.title: Runtime discovery only
options.body: Allow arbitrary provider-supported model execution but keep user-visible picker catalogs intentionally curated and mostly static.

options.title: Full live catalogs
options.body: Expose complete provider catalogs and rely on search plus explicit user policy to manage scale, cost, and capability uncertainty.

recommendation.title: Filtered provider catalogs
recommendation.body: Let provider plugins refresh live catalogs while core preserves the existing allowlist and applies provider-owned capability or recommendation filters to pickers.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent release integration and direct routing on this protected issue make steipete the best available product-decision owner.
